# Blazonshots LTD

> Blazonshots LTD is a Lagos-based technology company building digital platforms for students, businesses, and safer communities. We build student engagement platforms, business visibility tools, and mobile applications, and publish original, practical articles on student technology, campus app development, and digital trust and safety.

## Company

- [About](https://blazonshots.com/about.html): Who Blazonshots LTD is, our mission, and what we build.
- [Services](https://blazonshots.com/services.html): Digital product development, student engagement platforms, and business visibility tools.
- [Apps](https://blazonshots.com/apps.html): Apps and digital products built by Blazonshots LTD.
- [Contact](https://blazonshots.com/contact.html): How to reach us for business, partnership, or support enquiries.
